categories.name: Moba Signatures
categories.blurb: Our two most-loved plates. Rabokki is ramyeon and tteokbokki simmered together in one pan, and the dish our kitchen is proudest of.

notes.title: Ramyeon + tteokbokki = rabokki
notes.text: Can’t choose between noodles and rice cakes? You don’t have to. Rabokki is Korea’s original ban-ban, half and half, simmered together in one sauce so every forkful gives you the slurp of ramyeon and the chew of tteok.

categories.name: Korean Starters
categories.blurb: Crisp bites tossed to order in bold Korean sauces and finished with fresh veggies, the way Seoul does street food. Pick your base and we build the dish around it.

notes.title: Choose your base
notes.text: Cauliflower, potato or mushroom keeps a dish vegetarian. Chicken or meat makes it non-veg. Prawn dishes are served as they are.

notes.title: Ban-ban, half & half
notes.text: Can’t decide? Order any large starter as Ban-Ban for ₹149 extra and take two flavours in one plate. You can even pair a veg base with a non-veg one.

categories.name: Korean Crispy Bites
categories.blurb: Fried fresh, sauced to order. Pick a size, then pick any flavour.

notes.title: Flavour options
items: Gochuchang
Authentic Korean chilli sauce with a bold and spicy kick and rich umami depth.
Smoky Gochu
Bold Korean chilli sauce with smoky notes, balanced heat, and rich umami flavour.
Topokki
Fiery blend of gochujang, garlic, and savoury seasonings with a hint of sweetness.
Sweet Chilli
The perfect balance of sweetness and mild heat, finished with a delicious tangy kick.
Bulgogi
A classic Korean BBQ sauce with a perfect balance of sweetness, soy, garlic, and sesame.
Peri Peri Dusting
Zesty, smoky, and mildly spicy seasoning that adds a bold kick to every crispy bite.
Buldak, extra hot
Fiery Korean chilli sauce packed with smoky heat, bold flavour, and addictive spice. Not for the faint-hearted!
Ban-ban (half n half)
Choose any two flavours. Available on large orders only.

notes.title: Make a meal
notes.text: Turn any plate into a full meal: add any one of fries, cold coffee, lemonade or lemon ice tea at ₹99.

categories.name: Street Snacks
categories.blurb: Corn doggs, K-nachos and the snacks you reach for between bowls, all tossed in house sauces.

categories.name: Korean Mandu
categories.blurb: Hand-folded and steamed to order, then served your way. Five fillings, from garden-fresh vegetables to crystal-skin prawns.

notes.title: Choose how it’s served
items: Saucy plate
Perfectly steamed mandus plated over a velvety gochujang sauce with sautéed vegetables.
Broth bowl
Steamed mandus served in a warming Korean broth infused with gochujang and vegetables.

categories.name: Salads & Soups
categories.blurb: Fresh, light, comforting. Every salad and soup is made to order with your pick of chicken, fish, paneer or tofu.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.text: Salads are dressed to order, so they’re best eaten fresh. Soups are served hot in a shareable bowl. Ask for an extra bowl and we’ll split it for you. Paneer and tofu keep the dish fully vegetarian.

categories.name: Gimbap & Toppoki
categories.blurb: Rolled and simmered to order. Every gimbap and toppoki comes with your choice of tofu, paneer, chicken or fish.

categories.name: Rameyon
categories.blurb: Korean ramyeon built on a rich broth and springy noodles, finished with fresh vegetables and the filling you pick. Every bowl ₹339.

notes.title: Spice guide
notes.text: Heat can be dialled up or down on any bowl. Just tell us when you order. Buldak is our hottest; approach with respect.

notes.title: Choose your filling
notes.text: Every rameyon comes with one filling of your choice at no extra cost. Tofu and paneer keep the bowl vegetarian.

categories.name: K-Rice & Noodle
categories.blurb: One menu, your way. Pick rice (steamed and tossed) or noodles (wok-tossed), at the same price, then a flavour and a filling.

notes.title: Choose your filling
notes.text: One filling comes with every bowl at no extra cost. Tofu and paneer keep it vegetarian; chicken and fish make it non-veg.

notes.title: Make a meal
notes.text: Optional: add fries, cold coffee, lemonade or lemon ice tea at ₹99.

categories.name: Toast, Melts & Burgers
categories.blurb: Korean flavours on continental classics. Pressed hot in our panini grill, then finished with gochujang, bulgogi, kimchi and buldak.

notes.title: Made on panini bread
notes.text: Every toast and sandwich is built on panini bread and pressed hot to order: crisp ridged crust outside, melting centre inside. Never sourdough, never plain sliced bread.

categories.name: Boba Bar
categories.blurb: Shaken to order, 39 ways to sip. Freshly brewed tea, fresh espresso, high-grade matcha and ube, real fruit and never syrup.

notes.title: More boba? Always say yes.
notes.text: Every cup comes with a generous scoop of pearls, but the regulars never stop at one. Feeling brave? Add coconut jelly too, and a scoop of ice cream on top.

categories.name: K-Desserts
categories.blurb: Sweet finishes, Korean style. Sundaes and hwachae are built to share. Ask for extra spoons and we’ll bring them.

category_groups.name: Authentic
category_groups.lede: Where boba began. Freshly brewed tea folded into creamy milk, then loaded with warm, chewy tapioca pearls.

category_groups.name: Matcha
category_groups.lede: High-grade matcha, whisked fresh so it stays vivid and grassy rather than bitter. Earthy, smooth and never dusty.

category_groups.name: Ube
category_groups.lede: High-grade purple yam, naturally sweet and nutty with that unmistakable violet colour. Our most photographed cup.

category_groups.name: Chocolate
category_groups.lede: Deep, proper cocoa, not powder and sugar. Rich enough to drink slowly, sweet enough to count as pudding.

category_groups.name: Coffee
category_groups.lede: Freshly pulled espresso over ice, balanced with milk and pearls. The pick-me-up that chews back.

category_groups.name: Tender Coconut
category_groups.lede: Fresh tender coconut water and flesh, blended cold. Light, hydrating and quietly the most refreshing thing we make.

category_groups.name: Fresh Fruit
category_groups.lede: Real fruit, blended to order, never a syrup or a concentrate. What is in season is what tastes best.

category_groups.name: Banana
category_groups.lede: Ripe bananas blended fresh for that thick, milkshake-soft body. Korea’s café favourite, four ways.

category_groups.name: Lemonade & Iced Tea
category_groups.lede: Freshly brewed tea and real citrus over ice, the lightest way to drink boba. Sparkling options fizz.
